Ava: Heads-up — quick design review request for scorecard row density + approval flow copy. Want to land something that balances compactness with a11y. Prototype: https://figma.com/proto/abcd Sam: I'm leaning toward a slightly taller row (8px -> 12px) so text doesn't feel cramped. Also thinking about adding a subtle divider on hover. Rishi: Taller rows ok, but need to consider tokenized preview truncation. If we increase height we should allow two-line titles. Also the virtualized list performance needs height-fixed values. Marta: Two quick a11y nits: 1) hover-only focus indicators won't help keyboard users. We need visible focus style (4px outline) and tabindex on interactive cells. 2) Contrast on the "Approve" ghost button is at 3.9:1 — needs >4.5:1 or stronger visual weight. Sam: Good calls. For focus I planned to reuse our standard focus ring — will add to spec. For approve button, the design team prefers outline style, but we can increase stroke and fill on hover. Rishi: Implementation note: we rely on fixed row height for windowing (react-window). If we allow two-line titles for some rows but not others, list jumps. Options: a) make two lines for all rows (fixed taller height), b) ellipsize with tooltip/expand on focus. Ava: Option (b) sounds ideal for density, but Marta — is ellipsize + tooltip ok for screen readers? Marta: Ellipsize must still expose full text to screen readers. Use aria-label containing full prompt title and ensure tooltip content is accessible via aria-describedby when focused. Also set aria-live="polite" on dynamic status updates for approvals. Rishi: Pseudocode for accessible cell: ``
Summarize customer feedback…
`` Also will add aria-describedby pointing to hidden tooltip id on focus. Sam: Copy question: CTA currently says "Approve" / "Request changes" — product suggests "Approve batch" when multi-selected. Thoughts? Ava: Prefer explicit: "Approve checked" vs "Approve batch"? I think "Approve selected" is clearer. Marta: Short labels are better for screen reader brevity. "Approve selected" is fine. Rishi: For keyboard flow, bulk approve must be reachable via toolbar with logical tab order. We'll add skip-links or aria-controls so the toolbar announces when selection count changes. jenkins-bot: Deploy queued for feature/compact-scorecard at 1709203600 Sam: One more UI micro: hover state should not shift layout (no moving dividers). Use overlay shadow and change background tint. Ava: Great. Action items: - Sam: update Figma to 12px row height, add focus ring and hover overlay (due EOD) - Rishi: prototype aria attributes and ensure list virtualization handles fixed height (due tomorrow) - Marta: write accessibility acceptance criteria and quick-screen reader script (due 48h) Sam: I'll push a small variant too — compact toggle (dense/comfortable) so power users can switch. Marta: If we add dense mode, dense must maintain contrast and keyboard focus rules identical to comfortable. Ava: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after designs are updated. :thumbsup:
